description: Language-neutral golden vectors for the stateful indicator twins: trading_core VwapState / MarketStructureState (Rust, PRODUCTION — expected values computed from it) vs brutex.indicators (Python mirrors). session_day_ordinal is the proleptic-Gregorian ordinal (Python date.toordinal() == the Rust i64 day ordinal). expected_signal is [bos_bullish, bos_bearish, choch_bullish, choch_bearish].
